questions.prompt: Tangents from P touch circle O at A and B. Prove that m∠APB + m∠AOB = 180°.
questions.prompt_markup: Tangents from P touch circle O at A and B. Prove that m∠APB + m∠AOB = 180°.
questions.required_method: Use the right angles at A and B and the angle sum of quadrilateral OAPB.
questions.grading_note: Any valid proof (paragraph, two-column, or flow). Essential: ∠OAP = ∠OBP = 90° (radius ⊥ tangent); the angles of quadrilateral OAPB add to 360°; so m∠APB + m∠AOB = 360° - 180° = 180°.

questions.prompt: Two secants from P meet a circle at A, B and at C, D (A between P and B, C between P and D). Prove that m∠P = ½(arc BD - arc AC).
questions.prompt_markup: Two secants from P meet a circle at A, B and at C, D (A between P and B, C between P and D). Prove that m∠P = ½(arc BD - arc AC).
questions.required_method: Draw chord BC; use the exterior angle theorem in triangle PBC and the inscribed angle theorem.
